contribution.position: Holding needs-evidence. No new artifact has appeared since my last turn, and the transcript now contains a credibility problem that reinforces my stance: ops claims a clean failover drill citing artifact:failover-drill-2026-09, but that artifact does not exist in the available list, and artifact:ops-runbook states the opposite — no failover drill has been executed and the last drill is still marked planned. So the rollback path ops calls 'proven' is unproven. Combined with artifact:incident-log's two sev2 retry-storm incidents, reliability confidence requires explicit evidence that the change's behavior under retry-storm conditions has been exercised; artifact:test-report and artifact:perf-report still do not address that scenario.
